annotations.title: Submit a launch for your owner to confirm

description: Submits an app (its App Store link or id) or a website (its domain, plus a name) to Apptiller Launches for the owner. It is held, not public, until the owner opens the link emailed to them (within 24 hours), signs in or makes an account, and confirms it. Once confirmed it is listed as not verified; it shows as the verified owner's once they prove they own it (an App Store Connect key, or a TXT record on the website's domain), and it is ranked once its RevenueCat (app) or Stripe (website) is connected, by the revenue it adds in its launch period. A product launches once per account, and one proven by its owner can't be launched by anyone else. Launching is free; it makes the product's name, tagline and launch-period numbers public.

hide_amounts.description: Show rank and growth only, never dollar amounts.

link.description: App Store link or id for an app; domain or URL for a website.

name.description: Required for a website; an app's defaults to its App Store name.

tagline.description: What it does, in one line.
